4.
(1) The management  of the affairs of the Corporation
shall, subject to  the rules corporation, be administered by
Committee  of  Management  consisting  of  not  more  than
eleven office bearers inclusive of the  Chairman, Secretary,
Treasurer and such number of members as may be provided
or in rules and elected in accordance therewith.
(2) The first Committee of Management shall consist of
the members of the Committee of Management holding office
on the day immediately preceding the date of commencement
of  this  Act  and  shall  continue  to  hold  office  until  a  new
Committee  of  Management  is  elected  in  accordance  with
the rules section 6 of this Act.
